描述_EN: the figures, depicting animals, guardians and officers, were arranged in pair, one facing the other, and were meant to guard the burial area. sculptures of this kind were placed at the two sides of the 'spirit road' (shendao), the path leading to the tombs of emperors, high-ranking officers or aristocrats.
描述_ZN: 这些雕像描绘的是动物、守护者和官员，成对排列，一个面对另一个，目的是为了守护墓区。 这种雕塑被放置在 "神道 "的两边，神道是通往皇帝、高级官员或贵族的坟墓的道路。
